CaseIdPath.name: id
CaseIdPath.description: Case UUID（待验证参数；存在不代表有权访问）。

InviteTokenPath.name: token
InviteTokenPath.description: 不透明邀请 token；只作为 bearer capability，不构成 identity proof。

ParticipationIdPath.name: id
ParticipationIdPath.description: participation UUID（待验证参数；存在不代表有权访问）。

BindingContextHeader.name: X-Binding-Context
BindingContextHeader.description: opaque pending authentication context；不是普通会话。

BindingPersonIdQuery.name: personId
BindingPersonIdQuery.description: 待验证的 target Person P1；服务端读取唯一 Family。

IfMatchCaseVersionHeader.name: If-Match
IfMatchCaseVersionHeader.description: Transport representation of the existing cases.version optimistic-concurrency token. It is not a second business version. Runtime must parse the decimal payload and reject values outside 1..2147483647 before repository/SQL access; the regex is only a lexical gate.
